exposure: multifaceted and evidence-based caesarean-section surgical site infection (SSI) prevention program
enhancing prenatal education to discourage prehospital self-removal of hair
surgeries undertaken after >12 hours of rupture of membranes
cohort: 9,442 women who underwent cesarean deliveries between July 2007 and December 2012
finding: A multifaceted SSI prevention strategy, with periodic feedback of data, led to a significant reduction in SSI rates after cesarean section.
